_comment: CyborgPuppet firmware - flashing manifest for esp32_flasher (Android)

files.description: OTADATA - tells bootloader which OTA slot to boot

_single_file_alternative.description: Pre-merged single binary (4MB trimmed). Use this if your flasher only supports one file. Flash at offset 0x0.
_single_file_alternative._note: This is a 4MB trimmed merge (NOT the 16MB full-flash image) to avoid the 'Failed to flashDeflBlock' timeout error that occurs with 16MB padded images.
